why: In the first pair, the digits in each row are written in reverse order (right to left), and each digit keeps its same mirrored shape. Do the same to figure 3: 9879 becomes 9789 and 7979 becomes 9797, with every mirrored digit unchanged. That gives option 1. Option 2 is tempting because its top row is correct, but its bottom row was not reversed.
trick: With rows of digits, check each row separately: read it backwards and compare digit by digit, including whether each digit is mirrored.
